contact.basis: Dry public pavement1.5m seaward of the middle of the historic waterfront facade, outside native building. Fixed before source ground and geometry. No harbor water or terrace roof used as datum.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in signed native historic Palace facade frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.1m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; exact terrace/wall foot classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
